items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: he and I did a few things on our own... we promoted a couple of dances there

ctx.x: Normandie Hall again. It was about 1951, every Saturday night at Normandie Hall. You used to play on some of those.

Yes, I did. And speaking of Talbert, he and I did a few things on our own. One was at a place on Vernon and Central Avenue upstairs. There was a hall there. I can't think of the name of it. But we promoted a couple of dances there. It didn't make any money, but we promoted them...
